VI.description: Validates the setpoints of the selected operation before Start. Each value must be finite, greater than 0 and not above its limit in Simulation Settings (DEMO ONLY). NaN and Inf fail automatically because every comparison with them is FALSE. Message names the FIRST failing value in the order Voltage, Current, C-Rate, Duration.

Control.type: cluster{int32.UI Update Interval (ms),double.Max dt (s),double.Initial SOC (%),double.Rest Voltage (V),double.Ambient Temperature (degC),double.Voltage Time Constant (s),double.Current Time Constant (s),double.Thermal Time Constant (s),double.Heating Coefficient (degC/s per A^2),double.SOC Speed Factor,double.Charge Complete SOC (%),double.Discharge Complete SOC (%),double.Max Voltage Limit (V),double.Max Current Limit (A),double.Max Temperature Limit (degC),double.Max C-Rate (1/h),double.Max Duration (min),int32.History Length (samples),bool.Inject E-Stop,bool.Inject Overvoltage,bool.Inject Overcurrent,bool.Inject Overtemperature}

Node.fields: Max Voltage Limit (V),Max Current Limit (A),Max C-Rate (1/h),Max Duration (min)
Node.outputs: Max Voltage Limit (V):201.vmax,Max Current Limit (A):201.imax,Max C-Rate (1/h):201.cmax,Max Duration (min):201.dmax

Constant.value: [Rejected: Voltage setpoint must be > 0 and <= Max Voltage Limit (Simulation Settings).,Rejected: Current setpoint must be > 0 and <= Max Current Limit (Simulation Settings).,Rejected: C-Rate must be > 0 and <= Max C-Rate (Simulation Settings).,Rejected: Duration must be > 0 and <= Max Duration (Simulation Settings).]
